content.title: Days of Our Lives Actor Patrick Muldoon Dead at 57
content.text: where he played on the football team with a 20 role in the sitcom Who's the‘Days of Our Lives’ Actor Patrick Muldoon Dead at 570 seconds of 1 minute, 18 secondsVolume 0%‘Days of Our Lives’ Actor Patrick Muldoon Dead at 57Hollywood is mourning a shocking loss. Patrick Muldoon—known for his roles on Days of Our Lives and Melrose Place—died suddenly on April 19, his manager confirmed to Variety. He was 57. Muldoon’s sister Shana Muldoon-Zappa told TMZ the actor died from a heart attack, which occurred while he was in the shower at his home. Muldoon-Zappa said her brother was discovered by his girlfriend, Miriam Rothbart. Muldoon began his acting career while he was still in college at the University of Southern California—where he played on the football team—with a two-episode role in the sitcom Who’s the Boss? Upon graduating, he became even more well known with a three-episode arc playing Jeffrey Hunter, the once-boyfriend of Tiffani Thiessen’s Kelly Kapowski on Saved by the Bell. In 1992, Muldoon was cast as Austin Reed on the soap opera Days of Our Lives, originating the role until 1995. He returned more than 10 years later to reprise the role from 2011 to 2012. The actor also worked on Melrose Place, portraying villain Richard Hart from 1995 to 1996.On the big screen, among his major roles was Zander Baraclow in 1997’s Starship Troopers. He also appeared in various Lifetime and Hallmark movies and worked alongside Bruce Willis in 2021’s Deadlock. His latest movie, a thriller about a drug deal gone wrong called Dirty Hands, is set to release later this year.Michael Tullberg/Getty ImagesThe Los Angeles native also produced a number of films throughout his career, including The Tribes of Palos Verdes, Arkansas, Marlowe, The Card Counter, The Dreadful and Riff Raff. His most recent producing project was the film Kockroach, starring Chris Hemsworth, Taron Egerton, Zazie Beetz, and Alec Baldwin which is currently in production. Just two days before his death, Muldoon celebrated the film on Instagram, confirming filming had started in Australia and writing, “So excited to be a part of this amazing project KOCKROACH.” In addition to his partner and sister, Muldoon is survived by his parents Deanna Muldoon and Patrick Muldoon, Sr., his brother-in-law Ahmet Zappa, niece Halo Zappa and nephew Arrow Zappa.Ron Galella, Ltd./Ron Galella Collection via Getty ImagesKnown as “Bobo” to his loved ones, Muldoon was described by his friends to Deadline as “endlessly generous with his poetry, his humor, and his unmistakable presence.” They added that Muldoon “loved animals and people alike, gave unforgettable hugs, and possessed a rare quality of making others feel safe and seen.
